source_evidence: Exact player instruction 'Tell my steward Voss that Viscount Valenthia sent you' authorizes the scouts to use V's stated name/title as introduction to Voss at the western customs tower for preliminary discussions. H1 records Viscount Valenthia and Voss, acknowledges the introduction, and says he will take the proposed opportunity to his captain and direct a representative to the tower if the captain agrees. He calls off the other scouts and the three depart together back along the track toward their own route; they do not enter the intended ancestral-seat corridor or demand V's map. Immediate encounter ends peacefully, no combat, spell, check, payment, promise of employment, permission for armed passage, verified title/territorial claim, accepted price or guaranteed future agreement. No Voss notification, captain assent, messenger arrival or meeting yet occurred. V's existing authority for Voss covers preliminary ordinary negotiations only; no binding military commitment or new expenditure authorized. NPCs retain independent aims and actual knowledge. V/Cirren/Fenar/Mara remain on the road at their encounter positions; onward expedition available. No further travel/time, HP, inventory, money or supply change beyond brief farewell.
